name: Viewpoint-dependent subdivision of non-planar faces
definition: A method to handle non-planar quadrilateral faces in curvilinear grids by subdividing problem quadrilaterals into triangles and problem cells into tetrahedra, dependent on the viewpoint to avoid visibility sort failures and bow-tie projections.
summary: Viewpoint-dependent subdivision of non-planar faces prevents visibility sort failures by dynamically splitting problematic non-planar cells into tetrahedra based on the current camera angle.
